title: Marble Mayhem
intro.text: Every colour sends {n} marbles into the race. Before each race you secretly build parts into the track – then everything rolls from top to bottom.
intro.r1: Green helpers only work for your own colour: booster, spring, magnet, shield.
intro.r2: Red traps hit every other colour: glue, barrier, back spring, trapdoor, wind, brake.
intro.r3: Yellow switches can be flipped live on your phone during the race – shortcuts, diversions, cannons.
intro.r4: Blue events happen mid-race and hit everyone. And: the track changes every round.
intro.points: {total} rounds · every marble in the goal scores by place · +100 for the first marble · +20 per foreign marble caught
build.title: Build secretly now!
build.text: Pick 2 of 3 parts on your phone and place them on free spots. If two want the same spot, whoever is further behind gets it.
build.textLast: Last round: place all 3 parts – and all points count double.
reveal.title: This got built
umbau.title: The track changes
umbau.dust: The dusty side path is open now – now and then marbles roll in.
umbau.branch: A shortcut is open more often now.
umbau.wear: Row {worn} got a dent (slower), row {polished} is polished (faster).
umbau.items: Parts from this race last one more race, at half strength.
tg.farbweiche.on: You take {way}, everyone else the main way
tg.farbweiche.off: Everyone else takes {way}, you the main way
tg.kanone.on: On: shoots every marble one row on
phone.intro: Your colour – you have {n} marbles. Look at the TV.
phone.pickSocket: Now tap a glowing spot on the track.
phone.pickSwitch: Switches only fit on junctions (yellow spots).
phone.allPlaced: All placed. Tap a part to take it back.
phone.legend: Dashed = free · yellow = junction · faded = from last round · you can't see what others build. Drag the plan with your finger.
phone.mapHint: Big = your marbles, A/B = your switches
phone.noToggles: No switch of your own – just watch and cheer!
